tool_description: Persistent memory across sessions. Anna stores facts, preferences, project context and todos in a JSON file and recalls them in future conversations. On startup, recent memories are automatically injected into the thought buffer so Anna walks into each session already knowing relevant context.

available_commands.description: Store a new memory. Topics: anna_ai, projects, preferences, todos, general
available_commands.format: {"tool": "memory_notes.remember", "args": ["User prefers dark mode in all editors", "preferences", ["ui", "settings"]]}

available_commands.description: Search memories by keyword, topic or tag
Remove a specific memory by ID or all memories on a topic
Update the content of an existing memory
List all topics with memory counts
Get memory statistics: total count, topics, oldest and newest
Get the most recently accessed memories
Build and return the current memory context block (same as what is injected on startup)

tool_usage_guidance: Use remember whenever the user shares something worth keeping across sessions
Good topics: anna_ai (tool config), projects (project context), preferences (user preferences), todos (tasks), general (everything else)
On startup, the last 30 memories grouped by topic are injected into the thought buffer automatically
Use recall with a topic filter to retrieve topic-specific memories quickly
Use forget with a topic name to clear all memories on that topic at once
Max 500 memories — least accessed are evicted when full
Memories persist in memory_store.json inside the tool folder
proactive_triggers: When user shares a preference, fact or project detail worth remembering
When user says 'remember that...' or 'don't forget...'
When user asks 'what do you remember about...?'
When user asks to forget or update something Anna knows
On every startup — injects context into thought buffer automatically

metadata.notes: Startup context injection happens via context_loop — injects once on first run then idles. Storage at BASE/tools/installed/memory_notes/memory_store.json.
